newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks off highs after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks off highs after U.S. data.

text.p: French shares edged off the day's highs after U.S. figures showed a decline in April retail sales, with the headline figure showing a fall of 0.3 percent, in line with expectations.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 28.48 points or 1.06 percent at 2,721.57 at 1247 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up 28 at 2,712 from Monday's close.
The CAC index had hit a session high of 2,732.94.
